Ajay Devgn's Film 'Dhamaal 4' Sees Significant Box Office Growth

Ajay Devgn's film 'Dhamaal 4' has shown a notable increase in box office earnings, reportedly jumping 60.7% on its second day. The film's performance has surpassed expectations and is being compared favorably to 'Welcome 3'. Reports also suggest Devgn adjusted his fee for the project, though he remains the highest-paid actor.
